collection.title: Citroen Relay Van - Tailgate Rear Door 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a the Citroen Relay 2019 Onwards which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
